title: Verify before starting
instruction: Confirm the work is released, revision C is at the work stand, and all six tools are on the Gate 1 tool board, including T-117.

title: Protect the work area
instruction: Fit the protective cover kit (K-014) over the fan case liner, spinner and adjacent blades. Position the padded blade storage rack (T-529) beside the stand.
confirm: Covers fitted and rack in position

title: Remove the spinner
instruction: Remove the spinner fasteners with the torque wrench (T-063) in the sequence shown. Lift the spinner clear without touching the O-ring seat. Bag and tag the fasteners and discard the O-ring.

title: Release the lock plates
instruction: Release the blade retaining lock plates with the lock plate removal tool (T-208), one blade position at a time. Do not lever against the disk.
confirm: Lock plates released and tagged by position

title: Extract the blades
instruction: Support each blade with the blade support fixture (T-311) and pull it from its disk slot with the fan blade extractor (T-117). Place each blade on the rack in slot order.
confirm: All blades on the rack in slot order

title: Inspect and record
instruction: Inspect each blade against Inspection Standards Manual Chapter 72, Revision F, Table 72-21-3. Record any finding with depth, length and position. Do not disposition a finding.
